description: Defines the Connection class implementing the IConnection interface for buffer pool management in Android media hardware, including methods for fetching, flushing, allocating, and cleaning up buffers.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Implements the IConnection interface for buffer management, providing methods for buffer fetch, flush, allocate, and cleanup.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a buffer based on transaction and buffer IDs, invoking a callback with the result.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Invalidates all active or recyclable buffers.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a buffer with specified parameters, returning buffer ID and handle.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Processes buffer status messages and performs cache cleaning, optionally freeing all buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the connection with a buffer pool accessor and a unique connection ID.
